content: Motivated by these observations, we aim to improve implicit discourse relation detection by making use of easily identifiable explicit discourse relations and taking into account global patterns of discourse relation distributions. Specifically, we add an extra CRF layer at the top of the softmax prediction layer (shown in figure 3 ) to fine-tune predicted discourse relations by considering their inter-dependencies.
